strategies.english_title: Basic Idea of Dyadic Decomposition for Partial Sums of Nonnegative Nonincreasing Sequences
strategies.summary_en: For a nonnegative nonincreasing sequence, split the index set into dyadic blocks $\{2^k,\dots,2^{k+1}-1\}$ and estimate the contribution of each block separately. This converts a partial sum into a sum of easily comparable pieces.
strategies.applicability: Applies when estimating partial sums of nonnegative monotone sequences, especially in condensation-style arguments and blockwise comparison tests.
strategies.callout_body: 对于部分和$\sum_{n\geq N}a_n$其中被求和对象，序列$a_n$不增，非负，那么我们可以对自然数的子集$\{1,...,N\}$做Dyadic分解，把这个集合分解为$M_N = \lfloor\log_2^{N}\rfloor$段形如$$\{2^k,...,2^{k+1}-1\}$$的集合(其中$k\in \{0,...,M_N-1\}$)，以及一段$\{2^{M_N},...,N\}$.于是$$\sum_{n\leq N}a_n=\sum_{k=0}^{M_N-1}\sum_{2^k\leq n<2^{k+1}}a_n+R_N$$于是我们可以对每一段$\sum_{2^k\leq n<2^{k+1}}a_n$做简单的估计从而估计整个部分和。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Partial dyadic decomposition with a weight
strategies.summary_en: When the whole integrand is not monotone, rewrite it as $\omega(t)f(t)$ where $f(t)$ remains nonnegative and monotone. Apply dyadic estimates only to $f$, while treating $\omega$ as a weight, to derive a comparable series criterion.
strategies.applicability: Applies when studying improper integrals whose integrands are nonnegative but not fully monotone, yet admit a factorization into a monotone part times a weight.
strategies.callout_body: 有的时候我们也并不是一定需要对整个积分做基于dyadic分解的放缩，我们可以只对其中某部分进行这样的操作。毕竟要求整个被积函数单调，这个条件还是太强了一些。我们可以稍微推广一下之前的估计方法，如果我们可以把被积函数看成是$\omega(t)f(t)$的形式，其中$f(t)$依旧拥有单调性以及非负性，而$\omega(t)f(t)$不一定具有单调性，但是具有非负性。那么我们可以只针对$f$，利用单调性进行放缩，把$\omega$单纯看成是积分的某种权重函数，这样也可以得到一个广义上的同阶的级数。
